[[File:BlisslTuner-EpITVD.png|thumb|right|250px|A blissl tuner]]
A '''blissl tuner''' was a device used to tune a [[Blissl/Legends|blissl]] instrument. Such tools were used on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].
